About Us

ZETRON is a dynamic digital marketing agency based in Dinara, Rohtas, Bihar, founded by Nitish Kumar Gupta. We specialize in a variety of services including website development, social media marketing, Meta ads, video & reels, post design and SEO, to help your business grow online.
